decision.rationale: TXN-008171 posted on 2026-09-12. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-26, 44 days later, which is within the 120-day limit (time-limits). The posted amount is 37142 cents. The authorisation AUTH-008355 was approved for 25267 cents. The merchant's receipt DOC-000089 shows a total of 252.67 EUR (25267 cents). The posted amount is higher than both the receipt and the authorised amount, so under amount-above-receipt the difference was charged without agreement: 37142 - 25267 = 11875 cents (118.75 EUR). Under provisional-credit, only the part in dispute is credited, and this amount is well below the 3,000 EUR limit. The cardholder asked for the whole 371.42 EUR. The larger claim does not change the credit, because the receipt shows they agreed to pay 252.67 EUR. Only the difference is credited.
